# Muhammad Saqlain

> Aspiring cloud engineer and Computer Science undergraduate based in Faisalabad, Pakistan. This is his personal portfolio: projects, skills, certifications and resume. Available for remote internships.

Muhammad Saqlain is an undergraduate student at the University of Agriculture, Faisalabad (2024 — present). He is building a foundation for cloud engineering through Linux, networking (CCNA level) and AWS, alongside hands-on personal projects in Python and C#/.NET.

## Skills

- Comfortable: Python (scripting), C# (.NET / WinForms), SQL, HTML/CSS, Git, Linux fundamentals
- Learning now: AWS (SAA theory), Networking (CCNA)

## Projects

- PhishGuard: Static file-intelligence toolkit in Python/JavaScript. Shows SHA-256, MD5 and SHA-1 hashes, real file type and PDF red flags without running the file. Findings export as a PDF analyst report. Featured project, in progress.
- FastFoodPOS: Windows restaurant POS and management app in C#/.NET 8 and WinForms with SQL Server — order billing, menu and inventory tracking, sales reporting.
- [Student Management System](https://github.com/muhammadsaqlain-tech/student-management-system): Student records system in C#/.NET WinForms with course enrolment, attendance, marks and results. XML-based storage and full CRUD.
- Web Application Security Assessments: Authorized, passive assessments of live web apps — stack enumeration, security header and HTTPS findings, with remediation reports.
- Personal Finance Management System: Income and expense tracker in C#/.NET WinForms with SQL Server — category-wise budgeting, monthly summaries and spending reports.
